drifted.spec_text: When connected, each entry in batch_lookup MUST produce a log message via the ILogger receptacle
drifted.actual: Logging is unconditional — no connection state exists. Logs for every entry always.

drifted.spec_text: When not connected, batch_lookup MUST return Err(RemoteLookupError::NotConnected) for every entry
drifted.actual: NotConnected variant removed from RemoteLookupError. No connection state in interface.

drifted.actual: Interface now includes join_cluster and leave_cluster (not in original spec but are interface methods, not external public functions)
